description:
Also known as Lower Mackenzie Cruise, this singletrack, primarily downhill (North to South) mountain bike trail is rated blue. Fun and flowy trail with some technical aspects. Other trail activities also include e-biking, trail running and hiking. Dog friendly trail.

Distance 645.0 m | Descent -120m
directions: Accessed from the North on the Waco Connector or from the South on the Mackenzie Basin Access Road. (50.332200, -122.780860)
title: Lower Mackenzie Trail
